scope: First-party platform, fee, automation, login and profile restrictions used by the Russian-language cTrader decision page.

platformSource.name: cTrader Algo
platformSource.capability: cTrader supports cBots, indicators and plugins, with algorithm development in C# or Python.
platformSource.boundary: Platform capability does not override a prop firm's trading rules.

automation.firmRule: EA, bot and algorithmic trading are not allowed on cTrader; all trades must be executed manually.

countryRestrictions.notes: Existing cTrader accounts can continue until breach, after which they cannot be reset.

loginFlow: Receive the cTrader login email after purchase.
Open the cTrader Web Portal from the email.
Acknowledge the cTrader agreement and privacy policy.
Use the supplied cTrader login ID and password.
notes: The cTrader-specific article describes Challenge purchases up to $50,000; it does not establish cTrader availability for Stellar Instant.
The $25 platform fee is additional to the product list price and is non-refundable under the standard rule.
Country, citizenship, residency, KYC, payment and payout eligibility remain separate checks.

automation.firmRule: Bright Funded permits EAs generally and explicitly says API and automated trading are unsupported on DXTrade, but the captured article does not state whether cBots are supported on cTrader.

countryRestrictions.profile: citizen, resident, or living in the United States
countryRestrictions.notes: The article also refers to restricted countries without publishing the complete list on the captured page.

loginFlow: Select cTrader only after the checkout confirms it for the profile.
Use the Bright Funded cTrader web or branded mobile application.
Confirm the cTrader ID and account credentials supplied for the purchased account.
notes: The captured platform article does not publish a cTrader account-size cap or a cTrader surcharge.
Missing fee or size data is not evidence that the fee is zero or that every tier is available.
Country, citizenship, residency, KYC, payment and payout eligibility remain separate checks.

editorialBoundaries: The page compares two primary commercial partners and is not a complete directory of every cTrader prop firm.
No Russian Federation access promise is made from the Russian language of the page.
Unpublished Bright Funded cTrader fees, tier limits and cBot compatibility remain unknown until confirmed by the firm.
Temporary promotions are excluded from platform-cost examples.
